chapters.title: The Lord's Final Teachings to Uddhava

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
यो विद्यया मां विजानाति यो विद्यामपि तत्त्वतः ।
स मे प्रियतमो लोके सर्वभूतात्मभावनः ॥
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord said: He who knows Me through wisdom, and who also knows wisdom in truth — he is the dearest to Me in this world, seeing the Self in all beings.

verses.sanskrit:
एतावान् एव लोकेऽस्मिन् पुंसां धर्मः परः स्मृतः ।
भक्तियोगो भगवति तन्नामग्रहणादिभिः ॥
verses.translation: In this world, the supreme dharma for all beings is known as Bhakti-yoga to the Supreme Lord, beginning with the chanting of His holy names.

verses.sanskrit:
मद्भक्तिं लभते नित्यां मच्चित्तः सततं स्थितः ।
मत्प्रसादात् अवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
verses.translation: One who is always absorbed in thought of Me obtains eternal devotion to Me. By My grace, he attains the eternal, imperishable abode.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथिव्यापस्तथा तेजो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरिति ।
चतुर्विंशतिगुरवो मया प्रोक्ता उद्धवाय हि ॥
verses.translation: Earth, water, fire, air, sky, mind, and intellect — twenty-four gurus I have described to Uddhava indeed.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथ्वी गुरुर्धैर्यगुणात् क्षमायाः ।
वायोर्गुरुः प्राणतत्त्वात् स्पर्शनात् ।
आकाशो गुरुः सर्वव्यापकत्वात् ॥
verses.translation: Earth is a guru from whom we learn patience and forgiveness. Wind is a guru from whom we learn the principle of life force and touch. Space is a guru from whom we learn all-pervasiveness.

verses.sanskrit:
न प्राण संस्थानमिदं शरीरं यदात्मनोऽन्यत् किमपि प्रधानम् ।
न रूपमस्य विपरैति यत्र वाचो निवर्तन्ते असंप्राप्य मनसा सहैव ॥
verses.translation: This body is not the Self; the Self is something altogether different from the body. The form of the Self is beyond description, where words return along with the mind, unable to reach it.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नो भज मामकृतात्मभिः ।
भक्त्या परमया राजन् निर्गुणेन ससूत्रतः ॥
verses.translation: Endowed with knowledge and realized wisdom, worship Me with supreme devotion, O king, beyond material qualities and in full understanding.
